description: This file implements the SerializationService interface in the OpenMRS project, providing methods for retrieving serializers, serializing, and deserializing objects using different serializer implementations.

classes.name: SerializationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the SerializationService for managing serializers and object serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: getSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OpenmrsSerializer implementation based on class.

methods.name: getDefaultSerializer
methods.description: Returns the default serializer, either from global properties or the built-in SimpleXStreamSerializer.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object into a string using the specified serializer class.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string back into an object of specified class using the specified serializer.

methods.name: getSerializers
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered serializers.

methods.name: setSerializerMap
methods.description: Sets the internal map of serializers.

methods.name: setSerializers
methods.description: Initializes or updates the list of serializers managed by this service.
